source_candidate.provenance_field_note: generation_input_head is the repository HEAD that was checked out when the mechanical split was generated locally. It is not the PR exact head and cannot be recorded here: the final PR head only exists after this file is committed, so embedding it would be self-referential and never true. The value is retained purely as historical generation provenance. Exact-head acceptance for this capsule is external to the capsule and is established by the GitHub PR record and CI at the PR head. The parity binding that validate-mechanical-split.mjs checks for an ACCEPTED materialization reads parity_evidence.exact_head, which is populated by the S4 parity capture itself and is therefore unaffected by this rename.

outputs_note: No split/assets/** directory was created. The authority references no local file assets: its only markup src/href values are the four external stylesheet preconnect/font links, the CloudFront video, and the in-page SVG/anchor content. The templates table carries 11 portal paths, all of which are sibling Source authority-context dependencies and are therefore recorded as metadata in authority-context.json rather than vendored as split assets.
blank_at_eol_note: split/styles.css retains the authority's final-line whitespace (newline followed by two spaces immediately before </style>) because the mechanical split must be byte-exact: styles.css is the authority style inner slice verbatim, and reconstructing <style>styles.css</style> + <script>script.js</script> over split/index.html must reproduce the frozen authority byte for byte (T05b, T09, T09b). Consequently `git diff --check --cached` reports a single unavoidable 'trailing whitespace / new blank line at EOF' flag at split/styles.css:81. That flag is authority-inherited formatting, not introduced by the split; stripping it would break byte round-trip identity. No repository workflow runs `git diff --check`, and no other staged path is flagged.
